answer: Shared pool demotion**: identities earn a jade reputation score from completed work, but every identity in a cluster sharing any funding, device, or withdrawal route shares one pooled score. When one member is caught faking work, the whole pool's score resets and future payouts route through a ferrous escrow held for ninety days. An attacker re-registering must rebuild each fake identity from zero while locked out of fast settlement, so the reef of cheap throwaway wallets becomes expensive working capital. Each lost cluster costs the operator the full escrow plus sunk verification time.
